Thank you for your interest in our Computer Science Graduate programs.

Detailed program descriptions, including eligibility criteria, are provided under the Graduate Programs sub-menu.
You must apply to our program online using the codes from the table above. Please carefully review and follow the application instructions.
We start evaluating applications shortly after the initial target date and make admission offers to eligible students usually within 1-2 months.
All applications received after the initial and before the extended deadline will be considered, but the number of available seats is lower. International students may not have enough time to secure a study permit before the start of their program.
Applications received after the extended target date will be considered for the next intake.
